services.name: Class
services.desc: If you’re interested in training for a role as a lifeguard or swimming instructor, the YMCA is the place for you. Become certified to qualify for work as an Aquatics leader, either at the YMCA or the many other organizations that recognize our Lifesaving Society credentials. These courses teach the knowledge, fitness and leadership skills you need to guard and/or teach effectively. Bronze Star is an excellent preparation for success in Bronze Medallion. In Bronze Star, participants develop problem-solving and decision-making skills, swimming proficiency, and personal fitness. You will refine stroke mechanics, acquire self-rescue skills, and apply fitness principles in training workouts.
